Question 18
?

Given that the differential equation y″−8y′+65y=0

has the general solution y=e4x(Pcos⁡7x+Qsin⁡7x),

solve the initial value problem y″−8y′+65y=0,y(0)=2,y′(0)=1.

a
y=e4x(2cos⁡7x+2sin⁡7x)
b
y=ex(2cos⁡7x+sin⁡7x)
c
y=e4x(2cos⁡7x−2sin⁡7x)
d
y=ex(2cos⁡7x+3sin⁡7x)
e
y=e4x(2cos⁡7x−sin⁡7x)
